entities.name: Extended DRX parameters
entities.description: Information element used to negotiate extended DRX parameters between UE and network.

entities.name: ATTACH REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message sent by UE to initiate attach procedure.

entities.name: UE included Extended DRX parameters IE in ATTACH REQUEST
entities.description: Condition where UE indicates support for extended DRX by including the Extended DRX parameters IE in ATTACH REQUEST message.

entities.name: Network supports eDRX and accepts use of eDRX
entities.description: Condition where network has eDRX capability and accepts UE's request to use extended DRX.

entities.name: Network includes Extended DRX parameters IE
entities.description: Network behavior of including Extended DRX parameters IE in response message when conditions are met.

relations.description: ATTACH REQUEST message may contain Extended DRX parameters IE.
Network includes Extended DRX parameters IE only if UE included it in ATTACH REQUEST.
Network includes Extended DRX parameters IE only if network supports eDRX and accepts its use.
